messages:
Nadia: quick note  ran a micro-probe of a "peek-and-commit" speculative shim on atlas-7b-quant. aim: cheap early decision for short completions.
Ravi: baseline delta?
Nadia: p50 token latency 34ms -> 24ms, p95 145ms -> 118ms. throughput for <32 token prompts +14%.
Tom: quality impact?
Nadia: minimal. metric snapshot on our micro-regressions: exact-match -0.4% absolute, BLEU-proxy -0.2. overall perplexity stable.
Ravi: how does peek decide?
Nadia: 2-token micro-score + unigram match over last 5 tokens. if score>0.92, we prefill and route to int8 kernel. else fp16. lightweight and very conservative.
Tom: runtime hazards?
Nadia: caught one kv-tag mismatch in long multi-turn (1/400). added run-id on kv and invalidate on mismatch. streaming behaviour adjusted: we hold first chunk until quant commit for stability (+5ms first-byte jitter).
Ravi: cost impact?
Nadia: tokens/sec up ~10% on ded pool, approx 7% cost/token improvement.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: dedicated-pool-5, 30m window, 8% traffic, rollout id rh-peek-4135.
Tom: next steps: 1) run 5k eval with targeted adversarial slice; 2) run forced-quant holdout to bound worst-case; 3) collect bucketed metrics by prompt length.
Nadia: kicking off 5k now, will post CSV when done (~3h).
